raw_text: My family WhatsApp group is flooded with this CM audio clip. Everyone believes it's real. However, I noticed the audio quality is suspiciously uniform throughout with no background noise variation, which is unusual for a leaked recording from a private meeting. Some fact-checkers on Twitter are already calling it AI-generated. Can anyone confirm?
